results.content:
# Columbia Pictures Aquaverse Park Map 2026  
Every movie zone, slide, and wave pool at Columbia Pictures Aquaverse, the Pattaya water park formerly known as Cartoon Network Amazone, and where to find them on the day pass map.  
Columbia Pictures Aquaverse is an outdoor, ticketed movie themed water park in Bang Sare, near Pattaya. It opened in 2014 as Cartoon Network Amazone before rebranding in 2022.  
The current Columbia Pictures Aquaverse park map. Official artwork courtesy of Columbia Pictures Aquaverse; the source sheet is published at a lower resolution than most park maps, so some zone labels read best on the printable PDF. Use the printable PDF for the day of your visit, or open the official site.
## What is new on the 2026 map  
The current sheet reflects the park's full rebrand from Cartoon Network Amazone to a lineup of Columbia Pictures movie zones in Bang Sare, near Pattaya, Thailand.  
**Cartoon Network Amazone became Columbia Pictures Aquaverse.** The water park most guests still search for by its original name relaunched under the Columbia Pictures Aquaverse name in 2022, when the Sukhumvit area water park moved to a new licensing deal with Sony's Columbia Pictures banner.  
**Nine movie zones anchor the current sheet.** Ghostbusters, Jumanji, Zombieland, Bad Boys For Life, Hotel Transylvania, and Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs each carry their own slides and set pieces on the official map.  
**A ticketed day pass, not a resort perk.** Columbia Pictures Aquaverse sells same day and advance tickets to any visitor. It is not tied to a hotel stay, so plan around the printed operating hours on your visit day.
## Columbia Pictures Aquaverse map: frequently asked questions  
**Is Columbia Pictures Aquaverse the same park as Cartoon Network Amazone?**  
Yes. The park opened in 2014 as Cartoon Network Amazone and rebranded to Columbia Pictures Aquaverse in 2022 under a new licensing deal with Sony's Columbia Pictures, on the same site in Bang Sare, near Pattaya.  
**Where do I get the official Columbia Pictures Aquaverse map?**  
The current map is on this page, with the printable PDF one tap away. Columbia Pictures Aquaverse also posts a version of the map on its official site.  
**Do I need a hotel stay to visit Columbia Pictures Aquaverse?**  
No. Aquaverse is a ticketed day pass attraction open to any visitor. Tickets are sold at the gate or online, and admission is not tied to a hotel booking.  
**How do you get to Columbia Pictures Aquaverse from Pattaya?**  
The park sits in Bang Sare, a short drive south of central Pattaya along Sukhumvit Road. Taxis, ride hailing apps, and hotel shuttle transfers all serve the park.  
**Is there a printable Columbia Pictures Aquaverse map PDF?**  
Yes. Use the Printable PDF map button under the map above for the current sheet, sized for a clean print or offline save.
